बॉक्स ऑफिस पर आ गया बड़ा तूफान! 🔥
डायरेक्टर Nitesh Tiwari की फिल्म Ramayana ने पांचवें दिन मचा दिया है गदर। 💥
9 नवंबर यानी पहले सोमवार के लिए फिल्म ने एडवांस बुकिंग में 53 करोड़ रुपए का ग्रॉस कलेक्शन कर लिया है।
रिपोर्ट के मुताबिक, सिर्फ प्री-सेल्स से ही 45 करोड़ रुपए की नेट कमाई हो चुकी है। 🎟️
भारत भर में 25,300 एक्टिव शोज में 14.28 लाख से ज्यादा टिकट बिक चुके हैं।
फिल्म अब Ranveer Singh की Dhurandhar 2 के 60 करोड़ रुपए नेट के रिकॉर्ड को टक्कर देने के लिए पूरी तरह तैयार है। ⚡
क्या Ramayana पहले सोमवार की कमाई में नया इतिहास रच पाएगी? 🎬

ctx.title: Ramayana Box Office Day 5 Advance Booking: Storms With 53 Crore Gross Collection – Set To Beat Dhurandhar 2 For Biggest 1st Monday!
ctx.summary:
Ramayana is all set to beat Dhurandhar 2 on the first Monday as the pre-sales roar to almost 53 crore gross collection - day 5 advance booking report. 
 The post  Ramayana Box Office Day 5 Advance Booking: Storms With 53 Crore Gross Collection – Set To Beat Dhurandhar 2 For Biggest 1st Monday!  appeared first on  Koimoi .
ctx.text:
The post-Diwali box office momentum for director Nitesh Tiwari’s magnum opus Ramayana featuring Ranbir Kapoor, Yash, and Sai Pallavi is shattering expectations at the ticket window on the first Monday! For Day 5, November 9, the advance ticket counters across single-screen hubs and urban multiplex chains witnessed historical pre-sales momentum.
According to the final Day 5 advance booking report, Ramayana has recorded a colossal 53.00 crore gross collection, which means a net collection of 45 crore in pre-sales alone (excluding blocked seats). Having sold over 14.28 lakh tickets across 25,300 active shows in India, the film’s pre-sales alone have set the stage for an all-time record-breaking Monday performance!
With these pre-sales, the film is now positioned to challenge Ranveer Singh ‘s Dhurandhar 2 ( 60 crore net) for the All-Time Biggest First Monday Net Collection in Bollywood History!
By collecting 45 crore net strictly via advance bookings ahead of Monday’s over-the-counter walk-in footfalls, Ramayana has already guaranteed a spot near the very top of the all-time 1st Monday collections.
The total houseful count for Monday morning and afternoon shows has touched 289 shows, alongside 92 completely sold-out shows, fueled by premium 3D, IMAX, and 4DX screens.
With a pre-sales net baseline of 45 crore , adding regular over-the-counter walk-in footfalls across afternoon and evening shows is projected to push Ramayana’s Day 5 net collection into unexpected territory, surely beating Dhurandhar 2’s first Monday and script all-time history!
